fuzzy_doorway.name: A doorway reads your approach
fuzzy_doorway.description: Walk slowly or quickly toward a fourteen-rib arch. Fuzzy near/slow/fast rules open, curl or rest its geometry. Live museum body/XR-head input; visible rule weights, native reach/pace controls and separately labelled demonstrations.
interactions: Walk toward and through the opening; retreat and return.
Turn REACH and PACE to change the definitions of near and fast.
LIVE reads the visitor; DEMO SLOW/FAST supplies declared distance/speed; RESET restores defaults.
SWAP RULES reverses which approach opens the ribs; the displayed rule labels change with it.
fuzzy_doorway.qfep_connection: A responsive doorway classifies an approach according to authored distances and paces. Graded rules make its terms adjustable; they do not infer the visitor's intent or identity.
fuzzy_doorway.status: Installed after fuzzy_body in rear Shader_05_Patterns gallery
